mechanism_narrative: A sustained 5-month decline in the Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average signals weakening manufacturing activity, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings expectations.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls below its 12-month moving average for 5 consecutive months
failure_condition: INDPRO remains below its 12-month moving average for 5 consecutive months but S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 6.5% signals labor market deterioration, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and corporate profit margins.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises above 6.5% for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: UNRATE rises above 6.5% for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.
